verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, labeling, closing, or acting on many issues, PRs, or repositories at once. The REST API, GraphQL API, gh CLI, and MCP server are developer building blocks from which bulk actions could be scripted, so they earn no credit. Agent multi-file edits, security campaigns, and org-wide secret detection are adjacent features that the snippets never describe as bulk operations across many items.
